title: QA_Platform_move_draft_rfp_end_past_rfq_end
preconditions: A fresh draft event with an RFP round and an RFQ round, not published.
steps: 1. As the buyer, move the draft RFP round's end to one hour after the RFQ round's end (increase_auction_time + remarks).
expectedResult: No server error: a partial edit of a draft round is either applied or refused cleanly (4xx). Today the draft branch re-runs the full stage save on a partial body.
rationale: Lead from the support-ticket pipeline (ticket 900000003): moving a draft technical round's end answered HTTP 500 on two fresh events.
